system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, spend some time customising a weapon. Choose one: it deals +3 Fire, Electric (Shock) or Corrosive damage, or you roll Smarts for Strikes with it instead of its Core Skill.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.48
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, spend some time customising a weapon. Choose one: it deals +3 Fire, Electric (Shock) or Corrosive damage, or you roll Smarts for Strikes with it instead of its Core Skill.

automation.note: Takes some time to do. Edit the weapon: either +3 Fire, Shock or Corrosive damage, or set its skill to Smarts for your Strikes.
